title: How to Start Reselling (Even With $0 in the Bank)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest Shannon Jean runs a paid reseller mastermind/membership (refers to 'a member' and 'a student in our mastermind'), promotes shannonjean.com/resale and his X account, and has a long-standing buyer relationship with Costco. Most deals are live auction listings, and their profits are predicted rather than achieved.

idea.name: Liquidation/overstock auction reselling
idea.one_liner: Buy manifested liquidation pallets (B-Stock, GovDeals, retailer auctions) at 90-99% off quoted retail and resell the units locally or online for a margin
idea.customer: Local consumers on Facebook Marketplace; online buyers on eBay and Amazon; some wholesale buyers
idea.offer: New or open-box branded goods priced below retail
idea.revenue_model: Spread between auction cost plus freight and resale price

key_quotes.quote: I always tell people to buy with math and sell with emotion because if you use emotion when you buy, the math never works.
That's something that almost no one thinks to do is to like list stuff before you have it just for the research purpose.
Go find the kind of boring stuff that that other people ignore.

acquisition_channels.details: Facebook Marketplace for bulky items; eBay and Amazon for small items. Test demand by listing items before buying them
Wholesale part of a lot to shops or industry buyers to get the money back fast

ideas.delivery: Founder wins the auction, pays freight, stores goods in a garage or storage unit, lists them and hands over at local pickup or posts them
ideas.other_uk_rules: Selling as a trader brings in Consumer Contracts Regs 2013 (14-day cancellation on distance sales), Consumer Rights Act 2015, product safety rules and HMRC platform reporting (30+ sales or about £1,700 a year). The resale permit is US-only.
